result.question: How much cash and cash equivalents did Apple report at the end of fiscal 2025?
result.answer: At the end of fiscal 2025 (September 27, 2025), Apple reported cash and cash equivalents of $35,934 million (approximately $35.9 billion) [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue:2025-09-27]. Apple's condensed consolidated balance sheet as of September 27, 2025 lists Cash and cash equivalents of $35,934 million [0000320193-25-000077:ex-99-press-release-p003]. The cash flow statement in the 2025 Form 10-K shows an ending balance of cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash and cash equivalents of $35,934 million for the year ended September 27, 2025 [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p004].
